summary: Bitterroot NF lookout about 8 mi SW of Hamilton, MT: built 1934, staffed to 1969, closed 1971 or abandoned 1973; only pieces remain near the summit. Trail #208 is open.

facts.status_note: Tower gone; a SummitPost climbing page says only pieces remain near the summit

access.note: Forest Service lists Trail #208 from Roaring Lion Road as open to hiking, mountain biking and motorcycles; the lookout is gone

visit.trail_note: Trail #208 starts on Roaring Lion Road and climbs 6.3 miles to the peak; Forest Service gives 4,800 ft of gain (SummitPost says about 5,100 ft)

notes_for_editor: End date disputed: the June 1971 Ravalli Republic closure (via Forest Lookouts) against the 1973 abandonment on Firelookout.com. Not resolved; the story says so. Trail climb disputed: 4,800 ft (Forest Service) against about 5,100 ft (SummitPost). The 1964 station description (a National Geodetic Survey datasheet saying it was described by the U.S. Geological Survey) uses T. 33 N., R. 22 W., while Forest Lookouts gives 5N-22W-24; left unreconciled, record location not changed. Named staff are left out of the story. Forest Lookouts and SummitPost describe the summit remains only in passing; a field check or a recent photo would settle what is left.
